goal_claim_rule: NEVER CLAIMABLE: this Goal is a planning container only. Builders claim one contained sub-goal.

boundary_rules: Reception owns initial customer access, intent/service-fit routing and booking access; Sales owns commercial opportunity progression after valid routing/creation.
Missed Revenue Recovery remains one canonical Specialist under its existing Customer Access hierarchy and collaborates with Sales; no Sales Recovery clone is permitted.
Marketing campaigns/demand generation remain Marketing-domain capabilities; Sales may consume qualified demand and coordinate through Managers/Orchestrators.

Pricing, margin, finance collection, scheduling/capacity and channel transports are governed tools/domains, not separate Sales agent identities unless a distinct pain/outcome boundary later proves otherwise.

agent_goal_rule: This goal owns durable business/domain outcomes and may reuse, extend or create canonical workforce identities subject to non-duplication and outcome-owner tests.
workforce_goal_rule: Agents are permitted only for durable business/operational outcomes with a distinct ownership boundary. Reuse or extend canonical identities before creating new ones.
